proposals.before: On guichou Li Yue, deputy director in the Bureau of Appointments, was executed in the market for graft.
proposals.after: On guichou Li Yue, deputy director in the Bureau of Operations, was executed in the market for graft.
proposals.reason: 職方 is the Bureau of Operations, not the Bureau of Appointments.

proposals.before: On guichou, Li Yue, deputy director in the Bureau of Appointments, for corruption was executed in the market.
proposals.after: On guichou, Li Yue, deputy director in the Bureau of Operations, for corruption was executed in the market.
proposals.reason: 職方 is the Bureau of Operations, not Appointments.

proposals.before: On jiwei the Yanzhou river rose and drowned the cropland.
proposals.after: On jiwei the Yunzhou river rose and drowned the cropland.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yunzhou; Yanzhou would be 兗州.

proposals.before: On jiwei, the river at Yanzhou overflowed and inundated fields.
proposals.after: On jiwei, the river at Yunzhou overflowed and inundated fields.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou.

proposals.before: On xinsi the Yellow River breached its dikes in Cao prefecture.
proposals.after: On xinsi the Yellow River breached its dikes in Chan prefecture.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Cao prefecture (曹州).

proposals.before: On xinsi, the Yellow River broke its banks at Cao prefecture.
proposals.after: On xinsi, the Yellow River broke its banks at Chan prefecture.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chan prefecture, not Cao.

proposals.before: On wuwu, the Gansu Uyghur khan, the king of Khotan, and others sent envoys to court, presenting one thousand horses, five hundred Bactrian camels, five hundred lumps of jade, and five hundred jin of amber.
proposals.after: On wuwu, the Ganzhou Uyghur khan, the king of Khotan, and others sent envoys to court, presenting one thousand horses, five hundred Bactrian camels, five hundred lumps of jade, and five hundred jin of amber.
proposals.reason: 甘州 is Ganzhou, not the provincial name Gansu.

proposals.before: On renzi the court ended Guangzhou's tribute levy of hawks and falcons.
proposals.after: On renzi the court ended Guang prefecture's tribute levy of hawks and falcons.
proposals.reason: Chinese 光州 is Guang prefecture, not the more familiar 廣州 (Guangzhou/Canton).

proposals.before: On disi Yu Yanchao, Khitan military commissioner of the Tiande Army, surrendered with his son.
proposals.after: On dingsi Yu Yanchao, Khitan military commissioner of the Tiande Army, surrendered with his son.
proposals.reason: 丁巳 is the sexagenary day dingsi, not “disi.”

proposals.before: On renwu Cangzhou sent up a hundred sixty-five stalks of wheat with from two to six ears apiece.
proposals.after: On renwu Chanzhou sent up a hundred sixty-five stalks of wheat with from two to six ears apiece.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou; Cangzhou would be 滄州.

proposals.before: On renwu, Cangzhou presented one hundred sixty-five stalks of wheat bearing from two to six ears each.
proposals.after: On renwu, Chanzhou presented one hundred sixty-five stalks of wheat bearing from two to six ears each.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Cangzhou (滄州).

proposals.before: An amnesty spared their lives and sent them to Shamen Island instead, yet when mercy called them back they refused to come.
proposals.after: An amnesty spared their lives and sent them to Shamen Island instead, and even when later grace came they were not to return.
proposals.reason: 逢恩不還 records that later amnesties did not restore them, not that they refused a summons.

proposals.before: On bingchen the Yellow River broke through at Huazhou and wrecked the great Linghe embankment.
proposals.after: On bingchen the Yellow River broke through at Hua prefecture (滑州) and wrecked the great Linghe embankment.
proposals.reason: 滑州 is Hua prefecture (滑), easily confused with 華州 already rendered Huazhou in this chapter.

proposals.before: Tiger Swift commander Sun Jin, Dragon Guards commander Wu Gui, and twenty-seven others, for being implicated in Lü Han's rebellion, were executed, and Jin's clan was exterminated.
proposals.after: Tiger Swift commander Sun Jin, Dragon Guards commander Wu Gui, and others, twenty-seven men in all, for being implicated in Lü Han's rebellion, were executed, and Jin's clan was exterminated.
proposals.reason: 等二十七人 means a group of twenty-seven including the named men, not twenty-seven additional men.

proposals.before: On jiyou he waived the year's land tax for families struck by flood, drought, or plague.
proposals.after: On jiyou he waived the year's land tax for families struck by flood or drought.
proposals.reason: Chinese 水旱災 is flood and drought only; the idiomatic English invents plague.

proposals.before: Twelfth month, on bingchen, newly minted small iron pots and the like as coin, and coarse, inferior cloth and silk mixed with powder and drugs, were forbidden.
proposals.after: Twelfth month, on bingchen, newly minted small iron-and-pewter coins and the like, and coarse, inferior cloth and silk mixed with powder and drugs, were forbidden.
proposals.reason: 鑞 is pewter/lead used in debased coin; 錢 marks coinage, not cooking pots.

proposals.before: On wushen Li Huaijie of Fangzhou was reduced to colonel of the Left Guard for extorting goods from tribal subjects.
proposals.after: On wushen Li Huaijie of Fangzhou was reduced to colonel of the Left Guard for extorting goods from the people under his jurisdiction.
proposals.reason: 部民 are the registered people of his prefecture, not specifically tribal subjects.

proposals.before: On jiyou he left Kuangyi as Kaifeng prefect in charge of the upper capital and appointed Shen Yilun, vice commissioner of Military Affairs, to guard the palace and run the capital's Three Departments.
proposals.after: On jiyou he appointed Kuangyi, the Kaifeng prefect, stay-behind governor of the upper capital, and appointed Shen Yilun, vice commissioner of Military Affairs, inner-palace deployment and acting head of the capital agencies of the Three Departments.
proposals.reason: Chinese 以开封尹光义为上都留守 appoints the sitting Kaifeng prefect as shangdu liushou, not merely leaving him as Kaifeng prefect.

proposals.before: On wuchen he called at the Birth-Giving Abbey west of the city.
proposals.after: On wuchen he called at the Shangsheng Monastery west of the city.
proposals.reason: 上生院 is the Buddhist Shangsheng (Tusita) cloister; Birth-Giving Abbey mistranslates 上生 as parturition.

proposals.before: On jihai Wang Zhao, right assistant in the heir apparent's household, was demoted for overseeing the Great Abundance Granary while his son and clerks stole; he lost two ranks and was sent to Ruzhou.
proposals.after: On jihai Wang Zhao, right assistant in the heir apparent's household, was demoted for overseeing the Great Abundance Granary while his son and clerks stole; he lost two appointments and was sent to Ruzhou.
proposals.reason: 奪兩任 means stripping two offices/appointments (任), not two ranks.

proposals.before: On gengxu, an edict ordered the examination of one hundred six men including Sima Pu, who had passed the jinshi examination fifteen times or more; all were granted status as jinshi of the present cohort.
proposals.after: On gengxu, an edict ordered the examination of one hundred six men including Sima Pu, who had sat the jinshi examination fifteen times or more; all were granted status as graduates of the present cohort.
proposals.reason: 十五舉以上 means fifteen or more attempts at the jinshi, not fifteen successful passes.

proposals.before: On bingchen Zhang Yong, aide in the Palace Administration, was dismissed for foreknowledge of misconduct in Yingzhou.
proposals.after: On bingchen Zhang Yong, aide in the Palace Administration, was dismissed for having formerly governed Yingzhou unjustly.
proposals.reason: 先知潁州政不平 means he had previously governed Yingzhou unjustly, not that he had foreknowledge of misconduct.

proposals.before: On bingchen, Palace Administration aide Zhang Yong was removed from office for having known in advance of irregular governance in Yingzhou.
proposals.after: On bingchen, Palace Administration aide Zhang Yong was removed from office for having formerly governed Yingzhou irregularly.
proposals.reason: 先知 here is former tenure as prefect, not advance knowledge of the affair.

proposals.before: He decreed reburial for twenty-seven violated imperial tombs in the west—ranging from the Zhou kings Wen, Cheng, and Kang and Qin Shihuang through seven Han emperors, Northern Wei Xiaowen, Western Wei Wendi, Later Zhou Taizu, and fifteen Tang rulers. Each site was to receive fresh ceremonial and everyday robes, new coffins, and sacrifices from the local magistrate.
proposals.after: He decreed reburial for twenty-seven violated imperial tombs in the west—ranging from the Zhou kings Wen, Cheng, and Kang and Qin Shihuang through seven Han emperors, Northern Wei Xiaowen, Western Wei Wendi, Later Zhou Taizu, and the thirteen Tang emperors Gaozu, Taizong, Zhongzong, Suzong, Daizong, Dezong, Shunzong, Wenzong, Wuzong, Xuanzong, Yizong, Xizong, and Zhaozong. Each site was to receive fresh ceremonial and everyday robes, new coffins, and sacrifices from the local magistrate.
proposals.reason: The Chinese lists thirteen Tang emperors from Gaozu through Zhaozong, not fifteen, and names them.

proposals.before: At the yique new moon in the fifth month he took audience at Bright Virtue Gate to receive Liu Chang as a prisoner, then set him free;
proposals.after: At the yiwei new moon in the fifth month he took audience at Bright Virtue Gate to receive Liu Chang as a prisoner, then set him free;
proposals.reason: 乙未 is the sexagenary day yiwei; yique is a mistransliteration.

proposals.before: On the yique new moon of the fifth month, he held court at Bright Virtue Gate to receive Liu Chang as a captive and released him;
proposals.after: On the yiwei new moon of the fifth month, he held court at Bright Virtue Gate to receive Liu Chang as a captive and released him;
proposals.reason: 乙未 is yiwei, not yique.

proposals.before: and executed his chief ministers Gong Chengsi, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu.
proposals.after: and executed his chief ministers Gong Chengshu, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu.
proposals.reason: 龔澄樞 is Gong Chengshu; Chengsi misreads 樞.

proposals.before: his chief ministers Gong Chengsi, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu were beheaded.
proposals.after: his chief ministers Gong Chengshu, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu were beheaded.
proposals.reason: 龔澄樞 is Gong Chengshu; Chengsi misreads 樞.

decisions.reason: 職方員外郎 is vice director of the Bureau of Operations (Ministry of War maps and frontiers); Appointments would be 吏部.
The same 職方 title is mistranslated as Appointments in the literal; Bureau of Operations is the correct office.
The place is 鄆州 (Yunzhou); Yanzhou would be 兗州, a different prefecture.
Literal English names 兗州 for 鄆州; Yunzhou matches the graph 鄆.
河決澶州 is a breach at Chanzhou (澶); Cao prefecture is 曹州.
Literal Cao prefecture misreads 澶州; Chan prefecture is the right place.
甘州回鶻可汗 is the Ganzhou Uighur khan; Gansu is a later provincial name, not 甘州.
罷光州貢鷹鷂 names 光州, not Canton 廣州; Guang prefecture correctly separates the two.
丁巳 is the sexagenary day dingsi; disi is not a valid reading of those graphs.
澶州進麥 is Chanzhou; Cangzhou would be 滄州.
The literal likewise misreads 澶州 as Cangzhou; Chanzhou is required.
逢恩不還 is the exile rule that later grace did not restore them, not that the convicts refused a summons.

decisions.after: On bingchen the Yellow River broke through at Hua prefecture and wrecked the great Linghe embankment.
decisions.reason: 滑州 is Hua prefecture, not 華州; the proposed parenthetical Chinese cannot stand in the English field, so the disambiguation is Hua prefecture without graphs.
等二十七人 totals twenty-seven men including the named commanders, not twenty-seven additional men.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孫進、龍衛指揮使吳瓌等二十七人

decisions.reason: 水旱災 is flood and drought only; plague/pestilence is not in the Chinese.
新小鐵鑞等錢 are newly minted small iron-and-pewter coins; 鑞 is pewter in debased cash, not cooking pots.
部民 are the registered people of his prefecture; tribal subjects is an invented restriction.
以開封尹光義為上都留守 appoints the Kaifeng prefect as stay-behind governor of the upper capital, not merely leaving him as prefect.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以開封尹光義為上都留守

decisions.reason: 上生院 is the Buddhist Shangsheng (Tusita rebirth) cloister; Birth-Giving Abbey misreads 上生 as parturition.
奪兩任 strips two appointments (任), not two ranks.

decisions.after: On gengxu, an edict ordered the examination of one hundred six men including Sima Pu, who had sat the jinshi examination fifteen times or more; all were granted status as jinshi of the present cohort.
decisions.reason: 十五舉以上 means fifteen or more sittings, not passes; 本科出身 for these 進士 should remain jinshi of the present cohort, not the vaguer graduates.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 詔閱進士十五舉以上司馬浦等百六人，並賜本科出身

decisions.reason: 先知潁州政不平 is former tenure as prefect of Yingzhou with unjust administration, not advance knowledge of misconduct.
先知 here is prior prefecture of Yingzhou; known in advance misreads 先 as foreknowledge.
The Tang list is 高祖 through 昭, thirteen named emperors, not fifteen; the total of twenty-seven tombs matches that count.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 唐高祖、太宗、中宗、肅宗、代宗、德、順、文、武、宣、懿、僖、昭諸帝凡二十七陵

decisions.reason: 五月乙未朔 is the yiwei new moon; yique is not a reading of 乙未.
The literal likewise needs yiwei for 乙未.
龔澄樞 is Gong Chengshu (樞 shu); Chengsi misreads the final graph.
The literal name must likewise be Gong Chengshu for 龔澄樞.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows the English title Bureau of Appointments was produced only by misreading 職方; the office is the Bureau of Operations.
